messages:
oliver: FYI PR #8123 is ready for merge but canary shows a tail p95 bump on longseq. attaching quick bench output and asking for 2 approvals.

miriam: can you paste the bench command you ran? trying to match locally. :eyes:

oliver: ran: `./tools/bench_longseq --model redwood-medium --seq 4096 --concurrency 16 --duration 60`
output snippet:
```
requests: 960
p50: 18ms
p95: 142ms  <-- spike vs baseline 95ms
p99: 320ms
errors: 0
```

devlin: hmm looks like tail only shows on seq>2048. did you run with new kv-shard branch? that can add jitter.

oliver: this is on branch `pr/8123-kv-shard-opt`. baseline on main for same cmd was p95 96ms.

miriam: can you replay with `--batch-horizon 8` and `--kv-cache 1`? that matches our canary config.

oliver: re-ran with those flags, short output: 
```
requests: 960
p50: 20ms
p95: 108ms
p99: 290ms
```
slightly better but still above baseline.

tia: pinging CI: any resource contention on the canary machines during the run?

ci-bot: Canary run started on pool-gpu-b4 at 1759991200.
ci-bot: Canary run finished at 1759991330. logs: https://ci.internal/runs/1759991200

devlin: looking at the canary logs — saw occasional GC pauses in the shard manager at 1759991265. attaching stack snippet. could be scheduling thrash.

oliver: ok pushed a micro-fix to backoff timings (commit d7f3e2a). kicked another canary.

ci-bot: Canary run started on pool-gpu-b4 at 1759991375.
ci-bot: Canary run finished at 1759991420. summary: p95 102ms, p99 260ms, errors 0.

miriam: nice improvement. can we run a 5-min stability run tomorrow to be safe?

andrew: from a release standpoint we need 2 reviewer approvals. @miriam and @devlin can you give approvals if nothing else?

miriam: approve — looks acceptable given the backoff fix. :thumbsup:

devlin: approve with one follow-up: add a short note in the PR about the GC observation and the mitigation, so we remember when debugging future regressions.

oliver: will add the note and squash that in. thanks all.

andrew: merging once the note is in and CI passes final. :shipit:

oliver: added note and pushed. final CI is green. merging now. :tada:

andrew: merged and deployed to canary. monitoring for 30m.

miriam: thanks everyone — great async flow.
